_comment: Each run creates a new dated native Google Sheet inside the shared Drive folder below, via create_file with contentMimeType 'text/csv' and parentId = driveFolderId. text/csv auto-converts to a Google Sheet (proven by the sibling skills); text/html does NOT convert (stays a raw file) so do not use it. The brief is one grouped sheet: each part is a block of rows under a 'Section' value, using the shared 'columns' below. Last resort if the connector is unavailable: write a local .csv to the working directory. Output is recommend-only — the team reviews the Sheet and publishes manually. IMPORTANT: CSV-escape every field — wrap any field in double quotes and double any internal quotes — because Detail/Item/meta rows routinely contain commas; an unquoted comma silently misaligns that row's columns.
dataFreshnessNote: Ahrefs keyword/SERP data is fresh; the GSC feed (used for the cannibalization guard) currently lags to ~Dec 2025 — label GSC-derived findings 'as of <month>' and cross-check with site-explorer-organic-keywords when it matters.

rowConventions.Target keyword: Item=keyword, Detail=role + intent (e.g. 'PRIMARY · informational'), Metrics='vol 80 · KD 0 · TP 30 · winnable', Status='To use'
rowConventions.SERP: Item=domain, Detail=page_type / angle, Metrics='DR 94 · #1 · 34 traffic', Status=''
rowConventions.Cannibalization: Item=conflicting URL or 'none', Detail=recommendation, Status='Action' when a page already ranks
rowConventions.Outline: Item=H1/H2/H3 heading, Detail=what to cover, Status=''
rowConventions.Internal link: Item=page path, Detail='anchor: <text> · link IN|OUT', Status=''
rowConventions.Meta title: Item=variant text, Detail='recommended' on the pick, Metrics='<n> chars', Status='Recommended' on the pick
rowConventions.Meta description: Item=variant text, Detail='recommended' on the pick, Metrics='<n> chars', Status='Recommended' on the pick
